SAFETY DATA SHEET (SDS) 
Product: Crayola Washable Liquid Watercolor (Sunburst Yellow Base) 
Document Ref: SDS-CRAY-2026-AP01 
DRAFT / UNVERIFIED SAMPLE — NOT AN OFFICIAL MANUFACTURER SDS 
SECTION 1: IDENTIFICATION 
Product Name: Crayola Washable Liquid Watercolor (Sunburst Yellow Base) 
Formula Version: v1.0 
Manufacturer: Crayola LLC, Easton, PA 18042 
Emergency Phone: 1-800-272-9652 
Recommended Use: Children's washable art paint. 
SECTION 2: HAZARDS IDENTIFICATION 
OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200: Not classified as hazardous (as supplied in the provided text). 
GHS Labeling: No hazard pictograms or signal words required (as supplied in the provided text). 
SECTION 3: COMPOSITION / INGREDIENT INFORMATION 
Substance Name CAS Number Weight % 
Water 7732-18-5 78.50% 
Glycerin 56-81-5 12.00% 
Acid Yellow 23 (Tartrazine) 1934-21-0 8.50% 
Sodium Benzoate 532-32-1 0.50% 
SECTION 4: FIRST-AID MEASURES 
 Inhalation: Non-hazardous. Move to fresh air if needed. 
 Skin Contact: Wash with mild soap and warm water. 
 Eye Contact: Flush eyes with water for 15 minutes. 
 Ingestion: Non-toxic under anticipated usage conditions. 
SECTION 5: REGULATORY INFORMATION 
 LHAMA / ASTM D-4236: Evaluated by Board-Certified Toxicologist. 
 ACMI Status: AP (Approved Product) Non-Toxic Seal Granted. 
Important verification note: This document was formatted from user-provided text. The manufacturer identity, formula, 
ingredient percentages, hazard classification, toxicologist evaluation, ACMI status, and emergency number have not 
been independently verified. Do not present or use this file as an authentic Crayola SDS or proof of certification. Obtain 
the current official SDS and certification records from the manufacturer.

content.summary: This finished liquid watercolor formula for children under 12 has two screening concentrations within the supplied use-case ceilings and one concentration above a supplied ceiling. Water is entered at 78.5% against the verified use-case limit of 90% and is within the limit under rule usecase:us:paints:under_12:water. Glycerin is entered at 12.5% against the verified use-case limit of 15% and is within the limit under rule usecase:us:paints:under_12:glycerin. Sodium benzoate is entered at 9.0% against the verified limit of 0.5% and is above the limit under rule us:1:0:35:0, which is the strongest supported concern in the supplied checks. The uploaded CoA and SDS are both explicitly marked as draft/unverified sample documents, so they do not resolve the identity or certification-status questions raised by those files. Because one supplied concentration fails a verified screening threshold and the supporting documents are unverified, the preliminary direction is CL-leaning rather than AP-leaning, with document review still required.
key_reasons: The supplied concentration check for sodium benzoate failed at 9.0% versus a verified 0.5% ceiling, while water and glycerin passed their verified ceilings. The uploaded CoA and SDS are unverified sample texts and cannot be used as confirmation of AP status.
